page.overview:
Who is Isaribi?

Isaribi was part of a test that was meant to give shinobi the ability to breathe and operate underwater. Isaribi was one of the first test subjects, and was not the final version. She was sent back to the Land of the Sea to spy on the ships leaving port. Due to her bandages, which were used to cover the permanently scaled parts of her body, the villagers attacked her and vandalised her property. They feared and hated her, as she was the only person to return from being "spirited away".

Isaribi is shy and withdrawn due to her past, but at the same time a rather rude and cynical girl. She was very distant because of the hatred she experienced. Naruto described Isaribi and himself as being very similar, if not exactly the same. In her desperation to become normal again, she was willing to do anything asked of her. At the same time, she is not without compassion to others, willing to help people in need. Over time however, learning how Naruto shared a similar sense of loneliness from people rejecting him, yet still found friends and genuinely sought to help her, she happily accepts their friendship and gained a more positive nature.

Isaribi has purple hair and black pupiless eyes. Her face, arms and legs are wrapped in bandages that covered scales and she wore a sleeveless tunic-blouse with brown shorts. She also wore a simple yellow sash around her waist. When she transformed she turned green in colour and took on the appearance of a humanoid fish-like creature.

Due to Amachi's experiments on her, which gave her the ability to transform into a fish-man hybrid, Isaribi is a talented swimmer, able to rescue Naruto from the bottom of the sea as well to defeat several of his shadow clones underwater with taijutsu alone. The Kaima Form grants Isaribi enhanced movements and also the ability to breathe underwater. Isaribi could use the Water Release nature transformation and was seen attacking her opponents with strong streams of water. She also gains scales on various parts of her body, even when not transformed, which are strong enough to block a blade from penetrating her skin.
